exportReader.runtime: JSON/Markdown reader; no kit runtime or network required

compatibility.peerRangeMeaning: declared compatibility requirements, not an exhaustively tested matrix

designDirector.projectContextMechanism: benchmark project config context_files; ordinary skill reads context explicitly

notes: Review documents were uncommitted at export preparation and are not linked as files in the recorded source revision.
Their relevant conclusions and decisions are included in design-rules.md; they are not required to consume this bundle.

knownLimitations: Published package contents, integrity and SLSA provenance subject/source were checked. Cryptographic verification of provenance signatures was not performed. This portable JSON/Markdown contract is prepared separately from the npm packages.

Component property/default/state metadata is partial and explicitly scoped. Only SidebarRail/Toaster received targeted browser smoke; a full runtime, screen-reader and accessibility matrix is not claimed.
Density profiles, semantic spacing roles and new CLI/package contracts remain proposals.
HTML component markup registry is not exhaustively exported.
Director package docs and project context schema were inspected; no native import command or end-to-end adapter test is claimed.
